target_customer: Medical practices and hospitals with operational bottlenecks such as scheduling, calls and no-shows
problem: Practices lose time and revenue to manual front and back office work inside EHR systems that lack modern interfaces.
business_model: B2B services plus software, sold by demo with forward deployed engineers (no pricing published)
product_category: Computer-using AI agents and voice agents for healthcare operations

founders.name: Mathieu Rihet
founders.background_notes: Per the YC page: previously a medical interpreter, in healthcare for 2+ years. A press recap says the founders dropped out, which is not confirmed on the YC page.

founders.name: Georges Casassovici
education: Carnegie Mellon University (engineer per launch post)
founders.background_notes: Per the YC page: 5+ years in voice AI agents. Both founders say they spent two years as French and Spanish medical interpreters.

technical_complexity.rationale: Operating arbitrary EHRs by computer use, including legacy systems, while meeting HIPAA and SOC 2 requirements and handling live voice calls, is hard for a young team.

defensibility.rationale: Mapped practice workflows and EHR integrations add switching cost once deployed, but many voice receptionist vendors sell similar scheduling.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: eClinicalWorks announced its AI contact center in April 2025 and CareCloud launched a desk agent in Dec 2025, so EHR vendors moved into the same wedge. No acquisition of Novoflow found.

market_need_then: Clinics suffer no-shows and understaffed front desks. The YC page claims the voice agent answers every call and books directly in the EHR. No independent demand data was found.

branding.domain_note: The company uses novoflow.io, not a .com. Search shows confusion with Novaflow and NoviFlow. No source on how the domain was obtained.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and mission driven, plain copy about democratizing interoperability

branding.community_and_virality: Press recaps called the founders the youngest team in the batch, which drew some coverage, but no coverage of the brand itself was found.

brand_strength.rationale: A near duplicate of several other names and no mascot, press or community about the brand.

outcome_analysis: Novoflow is a Spring 2025 YC company that sells computer-using and voice agents to medical practices and is listed as Active with six people. The company site names its investors without amounts, and trackers report a seed of about 3.1M in late 2025 that no company post confirms. No exit or shutdown was found and EHR vendors launched competing agents during 2025.
notes: The round entry comes from the company website, which lists investors without an amount, stage or date, so stage is other and the amount is null. Unverified aggregator figures: 3.1M seed around 2025-11-03 to 2025-11-08 (SignalBase, VCBacked, FundedIQ) and a 500K pre-seed (Employbl); Employbl totals 3.6M. A Caplight headline about a 16M Series A is not supported. VCBacked lists Justin Hamilton among investors. Batch labelled X25 or P25 in places. Competitor search returned only later or undated vendors, so the list is empty by rule.
